messages:
maya_k: Quick heads-up — final onsite (virtual) for candidate ID 4821 is tomorrow 10am PT. Can everyone confirm panel availability? I'll need debrief lead + rubric scorer.
recruiting_sam: I can do 10am PT. Will be on the design/architecture slot. :white_check_mark:
olivia: I'm on, but can swap with @jordan if needed (conflict at 11). Also can take debrief lead if needed.
jordan: I’m available 10-11, happy to take debrief if olivia wants to swap.
samir_patel: I'm out that morning, can join debrief async — will add notes to the doc. Reminder: use the new rubric v2 (link): https://redwood.atlassian.example/rubric-v2
maya_k: thanks — @olivia if you take debrief lead confirm. Also reminder to open candidate packet in Confluence: 
```
Candidate: 4821
Role: Senior Infra Engineer
Packet: /confluence/candidates/4821
```
olivia: I’ll take the debrief lead. Quick question: for system design, do we score 'scalability' separate from 'tradeoffs' or combined? The rubric v2 looks a bit ambiguous.
samir_patel: Good catch — score separately. Scalability (0-4) and Tradeoffs (0-4). I'll update header before the interview.
jordan: For coding exercise, can we allow 10 min for follow-ups? Candidate usually needs time to explain. :pray:
maya_k: Yes give 10 min. Also pinging @calendar-bot to confirm Zoom room and add 15min buffer for post-interview debrief.
calendar-bot: Zoom link created and added to event: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890
calendar-bot: Room buffer: 15 minutes added. Reminder sent to panel.
olivia: Adding a short checklist in the doc for debrief: notes, score each section, flag any risks, decision rec (hire/pass/hold).
maya_k: perfect. One more: please upload any example solutions / code snippets to candidate doc after interview — helps for calibration.
jordan: will do. see you all tomorrow. :wave:
